title: 582. Continuous Subarray Sum

examples.explanation: The slice [2,4] sums to 6, a multiple of 6.
The whole array sums to 42, which is 7 times 6.
No slice of length 2 or more sums to a multiple of 13.

hints: Track prefix sums modulo k: if the same remainder appears at two positions at least two apart, the slice between them is good.
Remember the first index where each remainder occurs; a repeat with distance 2 or more is a success.
When k is zero there is no modulo to take, so look for a repeated raw prefix sum instead.
